profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases, founded in 2017 and based in San Francisco, describes itself as "the AI developer platform" relied on by thousands of companies as their system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications with confidence. The company's platform is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards, and aligned with GDPR requirements for processing personal information. The platform also helps customers comply with NIST 800-53.

The company offers Weights & Biases, a tool for ML experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage. W&B Weave extends the platform with LLM and agent tracing, evaluation, and guardrails capabilities. According to the company, Weave allows developers to add a library to their code to automatically capture information about the GenAI portion of their products, integrating with the existing Weights & Biases platform to enable quick reporting on AI performance metrics.

Weights & Biases was acquired by CoreWeave. The company is subject to 220 cases in California law exposure.
